Let's analyze what we have:

1. UserInputNode component currently uses:
   - Plain text rendering for the answer with `TextEffect` component: 
     ```tsx
     <TextEffect as='p' className='text-indigo-200 text-sm font-light'>
       {props?.data?.answer as string}
     </TextEffect>
     ```

2. TextEffect component:
   - Splits text by words or characters
   - Animates them using Framer Motion
   - Works with plain text, not with complex hierarchical markdown content

3. Markdown component:
   - Parses markdown into blocks
   - Uses ReactMarkdown to render those blocks
   - Has customized components for rendering code, etc.

The challenge is that TextEffect works by splitting text into individual words or characters and animating each, which doesn't work well with the hierarchical nature of parsed markdown. I need to create a solution that:

1. Parses markdown properly
2. Applies animations to the rendered markdown elements
3. Preserves the styling and structure of the markdown

I have a few options:

1. Modify TextEffect to handle markdown content
2. Wrap Markdown component with animation
3. Create a new component that combines both

The most straightforward approach seems to be to replace the current TextEffect usage with the Markdown component, and add animation at the block level rather than the word/character level.

Let's plan our implementation:

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,117 @@
- 
+ 'use client'
+ 
+ import {Markdown, type MarkdownProps} from '@/features/ai/components/prompt-kit/markdown'
+ import {AnimatePresence, motion, Variants} from 'framer-motion'
+ import {memo, useId, useMemo} from 'react'
+ 
+ // Animation variants for the container
+ const containerVariants: Variants = {
+   hidden: {opacity: 0},
+   visible: {
+     opacity: 1,
+     transition: {
+       staggerChildren: 0.05,
+       delayChildren: 0.1,
+     },
+   },
+ }
+ 
+ // Animation variants for each markdown block
+ const blockVariants: Variants = {
+   hidden: {opacity: 0, y: 20},
+   visible: {
+     opacity: 1,
+     y: 0,
+     transition: {
+       duration: 0.5,
+       ease: 'easeOut',
+     },
+   },
+ }
+ 
+ // Parse markdown content into blocks for animation
+ function parseContentIntoBlocks(content: string): string[] {
+   // Split by line breaks to animate paragraph by paragraph
+   return content.split('\n\n').filter((block) =&gt; block.trim() !== '')
+ }
+ 
+ export interface AnimatedMarkdownProps extends MarkdownProps {
+   delay?: number
+   staggerDelay?: number
+   animateExit?: boolean
+   customVariants?: {
+     container?: Variants
+     block?: Variants
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ const AnimatedMarkdownBlock = memo(
+   ({content, className}: {content: string; className?: string}) =&gt; {
+     return (
+       &lt;motion.div variants={blockVariants} className={className}&gt;
+         &lt;Markdown&gt;{content}&lt;/Markdown&gt;
+       &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+     )
+   }
+ )
+ AnimatedMarkdownBlock.displayName = 'AnimatedMarkdownBlock'
+ 
+ export const AnimatedMarkdown = memo(
+   ({
+     children,
+     className,
+     delay = 0,
+     staggerDelay = 0.05,
+     animateExit = false,
+     customVariants,
+     ...props
+   }: AnimatedMarkdownProps) =&gt; {
+     const blockId = useId()
+ 
+     // Create custom variants if provided
+     const finalContainerVariants = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+       if (customVariants?.container) {
+         return customVariants.container
+       }
+ 
+       // Adjust the stagger delay if custom value provided
+       if (staggerDelay !== 0.05) {
+         return {
+           ...containerVariants,
+           visible: {
+             ...containerVariants.visible,
+             transition: {
+               ...containerVariants.visible.transition,
+               staggerChildren: staggerDelay,
+               delayChildren: delay,
+             },
+           },
+         }
+       }
+ 
+       return containerVariants
+     }, [customVariants, delay, staggerDelay])
+ 
+     // Split content into blocks for animation
+     const blocks = useMemo(() =&gt; parseContentIntoBlocks(children), [children])
+ 
+     return (
+       &lt;AnimatePresence mode='wait'&gt;
+         &lt;motion.div
+           key={children} // Remount on content change
+           initial='hidden'
+           animate='visible'
+           exit={animateExit ? 'hidden' : undefined}
+           variants={finalContainerVariants}
+           className={className}&gt;
+           {blocks.map((block, index) =&gt; (
+             &lt;AnimatedMarkdownBlock key={&#96;${blockId}-block-${index}&#96;} content={block} /&gt;
+           ))}
+         &lt;/motion.div&gt;
+       &lt;/AnimatePresence&gt;
+     )
+   }
+ )
+ 
+ AnimatedMarkdown.displayName = 'AnimatedMarkdown'
+ 
```

   - Added smooth, paragraph-by-paragraph animation for the answer content
   - Set appropriate delay and stagger timing for a graceful entrance
   - Enabled exit animations for content changes

The UI will now display markdown content with smooth animations, making the user experience more engaging when new content appears.
